task: Execute Phase 1 queue lifecycle parity from docs/spider-foryou-plan.md
findings: The shared SpiderDiscover queue uses FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED and a platform/node key; lifecycle behavior is now extended with retries, terminal reasons, source provenance, idempotency, claim tokens, and leases.

Startup reclaims expired leases only; heartbeat renews active claims and cancels work if renewal cannot recover before lease expiry. Queue state is authoritative over informational visited markers, so stale markers cannot suppress retries.

A bounded keyset shadow mirror and generation-based reconciliation cover Instagram, Instagram bridge targets, TikTok, GitHub, Strava, Lemon8, YouTube, and Telegram. Full generations validate row IDs and source statuses before retiring stale shadow rows. No legacy consumer was cut over.
Read-only baseline captured GitHub queue counts and all legacy source status distributions. Large queues require repeated bounded mirror pages before parity can be evaluated.
